title: Drug–drug interactions — high-priority baseline (draft)
summary: Baseline high-priority drug–drug interaction logic, assembled from public-domain sources (the US ONC high-priority DDI list) plus original curation. Severity-graded; the full interaction set is authored from DailyMed/RxNorm/ONC during clinical review. DRAFT — clinician verification required before approval.
principles: Check interactions at prescribing and dispensing; reconcile the full medication list including OTC and herbal products.
Classify by severity (contraindicated / major / moderate) and act on the highest.
Prefer a non-interacting alternative; if co-prescription is necessary, adjust dose and monitor.

highPriorityExamples.pair: QT-prolonging drug + QT-prolonging drug (e.g. some fluoroquinolones + ondansetron + antipsychotics)
Rifampicin + many substrates (e.g. DTG, hormonal contraceptives, warfarin)
